description: Source code for managing command history in Zephyr shell, including ring buffer management, history traversal, addition, removal, and initialization functions.

classes.name: shell_history_item
classes.description: Structure representing a command history item stored in the ring buffer, including linked list node, length, padding, and data.

methods.name: z_shell_history_mode_exit
methods.description: Exits history mode by setting current pointer to NULL.

methods.name: z_shell_history_get
methods.description: Retrieves the previous or next command from history based on direction, copying it into provided buffer.

methods.name: z_shell_history_purge
methods.description: Removes all history items from the ring buffer.

methods.name: z_shell_history_put
methods.description: Adds a new command line to the history, managing ring buffer space and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: z_shell_history_init
methods.description: Initializes the shell history structure, setting up the list and current pointer.
